---

**The claim or behaviour**
What claim phrasing should be extracted, or what behaviour
should be detected? Quote a real description sentence if you
have one (fictionalised if needed).

**The evidence it would rest on**
A verdict is only as good as its evidence: what static
evidence in the package would support or contradict this,
cited file + line?

**Both directions**
What should the verdict be when the evidence is present —
and when it is absent? (A capability claim is never
CONTRADICTED and a quality claim is never more than
UNEVIDENCED; if your request bends those rules, say why.)
